verdict.rationale: Intel markets Copilot+ voice-command integration ('Say it and Copilot+ helps do it... voice commands to get answers, edit content') enabled by the chip's NPU, suggesting natural-language operation is possible on this platform, but this is an OS/Copilot+ feature rather than a native capability of the processor itself, and no independent or hands-on evidence confirms it works as described. Missing for 10: independent verification of voice/natural-language command functionality, details on scope/limitations, and confirmation this is chip-specific rather than a general Windows feature.
